subject: Weekly leadership cadence: trajectory, OKR scoring, QBR artifacts
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Maria Ruiz <maria@acme.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@nimbus.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Weekly leadership cadence: trajectory, OKR scoring, QBR artifacts

Team — sharing a short weekly leadership readout ahead of Thursday's prep session. Focused on trajectory (what’s shifted), a quick OKR status update, and a couple QBR artifacts attached for review. TL;DR: momentum on Dedicated throughput optimizations, a late risk around the EU compliance checklist, and two asks at the bottom.

Wins:
- Serving runtime: P95 token latency on the new batching profile improved by ~12% in internal perf runs (see attached QBR deck, slide 6). This should materially help the Hosted API tail.
- Dedicated: initial pilot with BetaCorp (internal test) shows stable 85% utilization with expected cost per 1k tokens down ~9%.
- Observability: Console rollout for trace-level token breakdown is live in staging; early feedback from Solutions shows faster RCA.

Risks / Headwinds:
- Compliance: the EU SOC addendum we expected this month is delayed. Nimbus procurement flagged the gap — Maria, their legal team is asking for proof of retention policies and an expected SOC-2 timeline. If we miss the cadence, Private deployments in region eu-west may need conditional waivers.
- QBR narrative: we still have an open metric on customer-perceived latency (post-cache) — product needs a clearer mapping between our simulator numbers and CRM-reported incidents.

Asks / Decisions needed:
1) Laura — can we greenlight a short EU evidence bundle to share with Nimbus this week (I can assemble a minimal pack)? Need approval to proceed by Wed EOD.
2) Hannah — can you allocate 2 FTE-days for an alignment pass between product and CS to reconcile simulator->production delta and provide a short README we can include in the QBR? Target: Friday close.
3) Marissa — final slide check: I pushed a v3 deck (attached). Can you review slides 5-7 (customer economics and risk mitigations) and confirm whether the backup model-variant fallback language is OK to share externally?

Attachments: QBR-deck-v3.pdf, OKR-scorecard-2027-Q2.xlsx

Next steps: I’ll work with Legal to assemble the retention evidence bundle if Laura gives the go-ahead. We’ll triage the simulator gap with Hannah’s team and aim to lock the deck by Thursday afternoon for dry-run.

Thanks —
Karthik
Senior Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

---
Note: External recipients (Maria + Procurement) are included for transparency; internal thread remains the action fabric.

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly leadership cadence: trajectory, OKR scoring, QBR artifacts

Karthik — thanks for the crisp readout. Short replies:
- Yes, please assemble the minimal EU evidence bundle. Laura approves a limited share under NDA. Keep it scoped to retention windows, data flows, and audit logs.
- Hannah: please prioritize the 2 FTE-days — this is blocking our external messaging.
- Marissa: I’ll review slides 5-7 after the legal pack is attached, but I’m ok with the fallback language if we annotate it as “subject to final capacity tests.”

One operational ask: if the SOC timeline slips >2 weeks, we should include an explicit mitigation slide calling out temporary restrictions for new Private contracts in EU until evidence is shared. Karthik can you draft that slide?

Laura
VP, GTM Operations
Redwood Inference

- Logistics: dry-run scheduled Thursday 10:00–11:00 PT. Please be on time — we’ll do a 30-min run then 15min Q&A.
